thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 HIGH - GPU pool exhausted in us-west-2, autoscale not keeping up (observed queue growth). Paging SRE oncall now.

sre-oncall: I'm on it. seeing lots of queued requests to inference-service-gpu. throttling 429s spiking.

miguel: looking at autoscaler metrics — HPA 'gpu-pool-hpa' shows cpu/memory stable but custom metric (prometheus/requests_in_queue) is flatlined. adapter logs show 504 timeouts.

priya: copying prometheus adapter logs: ``ERROR: failed to query remote: context deadline exceeded`` repeated every 30s. prom-adapter pod restart count is high.

jun: metrics-server looks healthy but prom-adapter is the bottleneck. Could be network egress to prometheus TSDB shard.

riley: customer impact: a few active customers report slow responses and increased tail latency. CS has one customer (AcmeCorp) on a video-gen job impacted. CS-rep please confirm severity.

cs-rep: confirmed — AcmeCorp observed job timeouts, customer-facing errors. They have ~1200 queued reqs. Marking P1 for customer impact.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) manually scale GPU pool up (reserve more nodes), 2) route burst traffic to cheaper CPU pool with smaller model, 3) clear stuck queue items. Which do we want now?

miguel: prefer safe: scale GPU pool by +4 nodes manually to reduce tail latency, then fallback routing if adapter still flakey. I'll run scale.

priya: I'll restart prom-adapter with increased timeouts and add temporary read-through to prometheus replica. patch: ``--prometheus-url=https://prom-replica-us-west-2:9090 --query-timeout=60s``

jun: before we scale, we need to ensure node quota available. cloud team confirms 4 spare GPUs available in account. go ahead.

miguel: running: ``kubectl scale deployment/gpu-worker --replicas=12 -n inference`` -> job accepted. pods spinning up. logs: ``pod/gpu-worker-11 READY``

incident-bot: Deploy job started by miguel at 6843219970, status: in_progress.

sre-oncall: while pods start, enable temporary throttling rule for non-critical routes to protect GPUs. pushing rate-limit config now.

priya: prom-adapter restarted with new flags at 6843220400. adapter logs show queries succeeding to prom-replica now. custom metric ingest resumed.

miguel: HPA observed new metrics at 6843220600, re-evaluating. HPA scaled target pods up automatically from 8->12 in response. queue length trending down now.

sre-oncall: 429s dropped by 80% in last 5m. tail latency improving. still seeing a few long running jobs causing queue headlocks, we'll evict them if necessary.

riley: notifying impacted customers: draft sent to AcmeCorp and BetaApps: "We experienced autoscaling delays due to a metrics ingestion failure; we've applied live mitigations (manual scale + adapter failover)." awaiting CS ack.

cs-rep: AcmeCorp acknowledged, asked for root cause and ETA. telling them follow-up postmortem will be shared.

jun: root cause hypothesis: prom-adapter experienced request timeouts to primary TSDB (high latency GC on the shard), causing custom metrics to be stale and HPA to not scale. The adapter's backoff caused metrics pipeline lag for ~12m.

miguel: mitigation summary: 1) manual GPU scale +4 nodes, 2) prom-adapter restart pointed at replica, 3) rate-limit non-critical routes, 4) evicted 6 stuck jobs from queue, 5) monitoring alert thresholds tightened.

sre-oncall: I'm going to run post-incident checklist: collect adapter logs, HPA events, kube events, autoscaler decisions. linking runbook: https://runbooks.internal/recover/gpu-autoscale (note: link for internal).

priya: opened GH issue to add adapter circuit-breaker and replica failover with health checks: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4892

riley: passing to next oncall for long term follow-up. @sre-oncall handing off to @miguel for overnight follow-up and RCA.

sre-oncall: handoff notes: system stabilized at 6843224400, queue length back to baseline, no further scaling events. next steps: full RCA, test prom-adapter failover runbook, add smoke test to catch adapter queries.

miguel: I'm taking on overnight. I'll keep an eye on GPU pool and adapter. If anything spikes, page me.

incident-bot: incident resolved -> mitigation in place, severity downgraded to SEV2 for RCA tracking. Actions assigned: miguel (oncall follow-up), priya (adapter fix), sre-team (postmortem).

sre-oncall: final note: customers may see delayed billing metrics for the impacted window; billing team pinged. closing channel once postmortem draft is ready. :white_check_mark:
